SYMPTOM: EBS item revision stuck at 00 while PD shows A/B
IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Repush change order or apply revision data fix
ROOT_CAUSE: Change order (NRCO/CO) not interfaced due to integration failure; Item Workbench used afterwards does not update revision
PERMANENT_FIX: Idempotent CO/NRCO interface with retry, alerting, and a guard that blocks Item Workbench edits on items with a pending CO interface

SYMPTOM: CCO created with no revised items fetched / wrong CO
IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Identify correct CO, recreate CCO with valid revision
ROOT_CAUSE: Revision sequencing not validated before CCO creation; latest ECO revision conflicts
PERMANENT_FIX: Pre-validate revision ordering and CO linkage before CCO creation; surface CCB errors at submission

SYMPTOM: CCB report error: old revision higher than new revision
IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Reject CO, move to pending, use a greater revision, re-push
ROOT_CAUSE: No revision-sequence validation at change-order entry in PD
PERMANENT_FIX: Enforce a revision-sequence rule at PD change-order entry so a lower new revision is rejected before it reaches EBS

SYMPTOM: Order lines cannot progress due to holds
IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Manually remove/release holds on the lines
ROOT_CAUSE: Autocreate Config Exception and buy-out holds applied automatically with no auto-release rule once the condition clears
PERMANENT_FIX: Automated hold-release workflow that releases config-exception holds when the configuration validates and PR/PO conditions clear

SYMPTOM: Receiving stuck, quantity shows 0, rows in RCV_INTERFACE
IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Data fix to clear RCV_INTERFACE rows (e.g. SBM-090351), reprocess
ROOT_CAUSE: Receiving Transaction Manager does not reprocess errored rows; no monitoring of RCV_INTERFACE
PERMANENT_FIX: Monitor RCV_INTERFACE for stuck rows and auto-reprocess; catalogue the clear-and-reprocess data fix

SYMPTOM: EBS deliveries not transmitting to BluJay
ROOT_CAUSE: EBS-to-BluJay interface has no retry or monitoring; mapping/endpoint failures go silent
PERMANENT_FIX: Add retry, dead-letter and monitoring on the BluJay interface; alert on failed transmissions

SYMPTOM: CPQ quote cannot submit order to EBS
ROOT_CAUSE: Item orderability / serviceability / pricing setup gaps for new products in the selling org
PERMANENT_FIX: Pre-submit validation in CPQ for orderability, pricing and serviceability before the order reaches EBS

SYMPTOM: APPTREE_EVENT error causes daily order processing outage
IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Configuration fix to the event/concurrent process
ROOT_CAUSE: Custom APPTREE_EVENT handler fails under specific data conditions with no guard or alert
PERMANENT_FIX: Fix the APPTREE_EVENT handler for the failing condition and add monitoring on the daily run

SYMPTOM: Hard pegging issue in planning (Test and Production)
ROOT_CAUSE: Hard pegging configuration/data inconsistency in ASCP/MRP
PERMANENT_FIX: Correct and standardise pegging setup; add a planning data-quality check

IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Provide config workaround to change the plant
ROOT_CAUSE: Org/plant change validation blocks the change under certain order states
PERMANENT_FIX: Clarify and fix the plant-change validation so valid changes are not blocked

SYMPTOM: Sales order headers need reopening for audit changes
ROOT_CAUSE: No self-service controlled path to reopen closed SO headers for audit corrections
PERMANENT_FIX: Provide a controlled, audited reopen process to remove repeated manual requests

SYMPTOM: DropShip order data corruption after cancellation
IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Apply data fix to unlink/clean up the PO
ROOT_CAUSE: DropShip cancellation flow does not unlink the PO, leaving corrupt referential links
PERMANENT_FIX: Fix the DropShip cancellation to unlink the PO automatically and add a referential-integrity check

SYMPTOM: Obligation error blocks revenue recognition / billing
ROOT_CAUSE: Revenue obligation / contingency setup incomplete for the project billing scenario
PERMANENT_FIX: Complete obligation and contingency setup; add a pre-billing validation

IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Raise Oracle SR, track via SCTASK
ROOT_CAUSE: Order-to-contract cardinality not behaving as expected; suspected product defect
PERMANENT_FIX: Confirm intended cardinality with Oracle; apply the patch/config once the SR resolves

SYMPTOM: AR AutoInvoice rejections (no revenue account, tax, period)
IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Correct the line or AutoAccounting and re-run AutoInvoice (RAXMTR)
ROOT_CAUSE: AutoAccounting and tax setup have gaps for new batch sources and product lines, so AutoInvoice cannot derive the revenue CCID or tax
PERMANENT_FIX: Complete AutoAccounting and tax setup for all batch sources, and add a pre-AutoInvoice validation report that catches missing accounts before the run

SYMPTOM: AP invoice import fails PO matching (qty/no match)
IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Reconcile receipt/PO and resubmit Payables Open Interface Import
ROOT_CAUSE: Goods receipt not completed or PO line mismatch, so the invoice cannot 3-way match within tolerance
PERMANENT_FIX: Enforce receipt-required and matching tolerances at supplier and PO setup, and alert on stuck interface rejections

SYMPTOM: AP invoice on price hold (invoice price over PO tolerance)
IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Review price difference, release hold after approval or correct PO price
ROOT_CAUSE: Invoice unit price exceeds the PO price within tolerance because PO price agreements are not kept current
PERMANENT_FIX: Keep PO price agreements current and tighten price tolerance governance to stop recurring price holds

SYMPTOM: AP invoice rejected on validation (supplier site / tax / account)
IMMEDIATE_RESOLUTION: Complete supplier site, tax registration or account setup and revalidate
ROOT_CAUSE: Supplier site, tax registration or distribution account setup is incomplete at onboarding
PERMANENT_FIX: Make supplier onboarding enforce tax registration and default accounting so invoices validate first time
